# pytest and what it needs, pinned by hash: core-and-tests, win-build,
# macos-build and linux-build run the havne package's tests
# (PythonTest.*, python/tests/) with it against the shared core they
# build. Pure-Python wheels only; colorama is pytest's on Windows alone.
# exceptiongroup and tomli (pytest's below Python 3.11) are left out: the
# package needs 3.11 or later. Bumped by hand: take each wheel's sha256
# from https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json and check the set with
# pip install --require-hashes in a scratch venv.
